headline: Deribit Intake Rises To 244.1 Million Dollars From 197.9 Million As OKX Falls To 136.6 Million
narrative: Deribit clean-asset intake rose to a 244.1 million dollar inflow from 197.9 million dollars, while OKX intake fell to 136.6 million dollars from 196.2 million dollars. Gate took in 181.4 million dollars and Bybit took in 95.1 million dollars, while Binance posted a 225.1 million dollar outflow, Crypto.com a 60.6 million dollar outflow, and Bitget a 54.4 million dollar outflow, leaving a 319.6 million dollar net inflow across 79 venues, equal to 0.1169 percent of the 273.4 billion dollars held there excluding each venue's own token. The pipe measures the 24-hour change in dollars held on the venues excluding each exchange's own token, so the Deribit rise means more clean-asset value arrived at that venue than on the prior reading, and the OKX drop means less arrived there.
author: jordan
